topics.label: Browser agents
topics.description: Agents that operate websites and complete tasks through browser interfaces.

topics.label: Multi-agent orchestration
topics.description: Systems that delegate tasks between multiple agents and coordinate their work.

topics.label: AI coding agents
topics.description: Agents that inspect a codebase, edit code and run tests. Human review is still needed; ordinary code completion is outside this topic.

topics.label: Agent evaluation and reliability
topics.description: Testing, tracing and measuring whether agents complete real tasks reliably.

topics.label: Collaborative AI workspaces
topics.description: Shared workspaces where people and AI collaborate on projects and documents.

topics.label: Agent development platforms
topics.description: Tools and managed services for building, deploying and operating agents.
topics.pattern: \b(managed agents?|agent platforms?|agents? sdk|agent development platforms?|build.{0,18}production-ready agents?)\b

topics.label: AI search and answer engines
topics.description: Search products that generate answers or conduct research from retrieved sources.
topics.pattern: \b(ai search|answer engines?|perplexity|search copilots?|generative search|ai-powered search|ai mode.{0,48}search|search.{0,48}ai mode)\b

topics.label: In-browser model inference
topics.description: Models executed inside a web browser rather than a remote inference service.

topics.label: Real-time voice agents
topics.description: Interactive agents that listen and respond through live speech.

topics.label: Speech and audio models
topics.description: Models for speech recognition, synthesis, cloning and audio understanding.

topics.label: AI video generation and production
topics.description: AI video generation and its use in film, advertising and production workflows.
topics.pattern: \b(text.to.video|video (?:generation|ai)|generative video|ai video models?|ai.generated (?:video|film)|ai film(?:making)?|video ai models?)\b

topics.label: Image generation models
topics.description: Models and tools that generate or edit images.
topics.pattern: \b(image generation|image creation|generative image|ai image models?|diffusion models?)\b

topics.label: Humanoid robotics
topics.description: Human-shaped robots and their real deployments.

topics.label: Robot foundation models
topics.description: Models that learn perception and actions for robots in the physical world.

topics.label: AI wearables and smart glasses
topics.description: Glasses, pendants and other wearable devices with concrete AI capabilities.

topics.label: AI inference chips
topics.description: Processors and accelerators used to execute AI models.

topics.label: On-device AI
topics.description: AI inference on local phones, PCs and edge devices.

topics.label: Open-weight models
topics.description: Models released with downloadable weights; a vendor mention alone is insufficient.

topics.label: Reasoning models
topics.description: Models and inference methods that spend additional computation on reasoning.

topics.label: Multimodal models
topics.description: Models that combine vision, text, audio or other input and output modalities.

topics.label: Long-context models
topics.description: Changes in how much context models can process and use reliably.

topics.label: Model evaluation and benchmarks
topics.description: Benchmarks and evaluations of model capabilities and limitations.

topics.label: Model observability and guardrails
topics.description: Monitoring model behavior, detecting failures and applying runtime guardrails.

topics.label: AI content authenticity
topics.description: Provenance, watermarking and verification of AI-generated media.

topics.label: Clinical AI systems
topics.description: AI used in clinical diagnosis, treatment and medical workflows.

topics.label: AI marketing workflows
topics.description: AI used in marketing production, campaigns and measurement, including ads explicitly designed for AI agents.
topics.pattern: \b(ai marketing|ads? for ai agents?|advertis(?:ing|ements?).{0,30}ai agents?|marketing copilots?|marketing.{0,24}ai tools?|ai.{0,24}marketing workflow)\b

topics.label: AI customer-service agents
topics.description: Agents and automation for customer support and contact centers.
topics.pattern: \b(ai customer service|customer service agents?|contact cent(?:er|re).{0,24}ai|support agents?.{0,24}ai)\b

topics.label: AI sales copilots
topics.description: AI used in prospecting, sales assistance and revenue workflows.

topics.label: Enterprise AI workflow automation
topics.description: AI agents that carry out enterprise processes, including legal and recruiting workflows. Ordinary non-AI business software is excluded.
topics.pattern: \b(ai workflow automation|enterprise automation.{0,20}ai|agentic process automation|business workflow agents?|legal ai agents?|(?:legal|recruiting|hiring) (?:ai )?(?:agents?|assistants?))\b

topics.label: AI companions
topics.description: AI products designed for ongoing social or emotional companionship.

topics.label: AI shopping assistants
topics.description: Agents that discover products, assist purchases or conduct commerce.

topics.label: AI creator tools
topics.description: AI production tools used by creators across media formats.

topics.label: AI funding rounds
topics.description: Financing of AI companies; funding is context rather than proof of product adoption.

topics.label: AI acquisitions
topics.description: Acquisitions and mergers involving AI products or companies.

topics.label: AI regulation
topics.description: Proposed and enacted AI regulation; distinguish proposals from binding rules.

topics.label: AI copyright disputes
topics.description: Disputes over copyright, training data and AI-generated works.

topics.label: Frontier-model safety
topics.description: Research and controls addressing harmful or misaligned frontier-model behavior.
topics.pattern: \b(model safety|ai safety testing|alignment research|frontier model safety|responsible ai)\b

topics.label: AI cybersecurity and misuse
topics.description: AI used to discover vulnerabilities, defend systems or automate attacks. Distinct from ordinary coding agents and general model safety.
topics.pattern: \b(ai.powered cyber|ai.enabled cyber|ai.driven cyber|ai.orchestrated cyber|ai.{0,25}(?:cyberattacks?|cybersecurity|vulnerabilit)|(?:claude|grok|agents?).{0,45}(?:hack(?:ers?|ing)?|cyberattacks?|attacks? on banks)|cyber verification|cyber mission)\b

topics.label: Agent identity, permissions and access
topics.description: Agent ownership, identity, least-privilege permissions, runtime access controls and external-agent access fees. Ordinary SaaS pricing and general cybersecurity are outside this topic.

topics.label: AI compute capacity and economics
topics.description: AI data-center capacity, power constraints, GPU-cloud financing and inference costs. Distinct from chip designs and generic corporate earnings.

topics.label: AI industrial robotics
topics.description: AI-controlled industrial arms, flexible factories and manufacturing robots. Do not infer humanoid deployment from general robotics news.

topics.label: Model efficiency and distillation
topics.description: Distillation, compression and task-specific small models that reduce inference cost. Separate technical efficiency from cloud capacity and financing.

groups.label: Models and media
groups.description: Model capability, evaluation and media generation

groups.label: Infrastructure and devices
groups.description: Deployment, compute capacity, chips and devices
